content: भ्रमः [भ्रम्-घञ्] .²1 Moving or roaming about, roving. .²2 Turning round, whirling, revolving. .²3 Circular motion, rotation. .²4 Straying, deviating. .²5 An error, a mistake, misapprehension, delusion; शुक्तौ रजतमिति ज्ञानं भ्रमः; भ्रमं संमोहमावर्तमभ्यासाद्विनिवर्तयेत् <ls>Mb. 12. 274. 7</ls>; भ्रमो द्विविधः विपर्यासः संशयश्च <ls>T. S.</ls> .²6 Confusion, perplexity, embarrassment. .²7 An eddy, a whirlpool. .²8 A potterʼs wheel. .²9 A grind-stone. .²10 A lathe. .²11 Giddiness. .²12 A fountain, water-course; भ्रमागतैरम्बुभिरम्बुराशिः <ls>Śi. 3. 38</ls>. .²13 An umbrella. .²14 A circle.
